name: BandiView
price: Free trial (non-commercial home use, ads, some features locked); Professional $39 one-time (1 PC), $58.50 (2 PC), volume discounts
summary: Honeyview's successor from the makers of Bandizip: a fast single-image viewer for Windows 10/11 with archive and comic reading, smart double-page and webtoon modes, HDR output and a fast batch converter. Very popular in Korea for manga and webtoon reading.
where_it_wins: Webtoon vertical strip mode and smart double-page manga mode
Clip Studio Paint, HEIC (PRO), many archive formats (ALZ, EGG, ISO, ZPAQ …)
Customizable keyboard and mouse shortcuts, also in the free version
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon), Honeyview/BandiView-style viewing without Windows or Wine
Plays videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI …) in the same grid and slideshow
Thumbnail grid with folder previews and list view, recursive name search with regular expressions
Free with every feature, no ads, open source, App Sandbox, never goes online
Dual pane with F5/F6 copy/move, undo for file actions
No ads and no non-commercial restriction

free.note: Free trial edition for non-commercial home use only, with ads and some features locked; Professional edition $39 (1 PC), $58.50 (2 PC)

no_account_no_tracking.note: No account needed, but the free trial edition shows ads; PRO has no ads

dark_light_setting.note: Dark themed UI since v8.0 (Sep 2026); docs don't say whether it can be set apart from the Windows setting

languages_20.note: Community translations; Bandisoft sites and apps in 13+ languages incl. Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian; exact app count not listed

folder_browsing.note: Opens a file or folder (F) and pages through that folder; no import

thumbnail_grid.note: No thumbnail browser window; a 'Select Image' dialog shows a filmstrip of the folder's thumbnails above a file list

list_view.note: 'Select Image' dialog lists files with name, date modified and size columns

recursive_search.note: No file name search inside the viewer

regex_search.note: No file name search inside the viewer

network_shares_fast.note: Works on NAS (changelog fixes a NAS bug); no speed claims for network folders

multiple_windows.note: New window: Ctrl+N; option to forbid multiple instances

bookmarks.note: Bookmarks are per image file (B, Bookmark Manager since v8.0), not folder favourites; plus up to 20 copy/move target 'Photo Folders'

img_modern_formats.note: AVIF, JXL, WebP free; HEIC/HEIF only in the Professional edition

img_raw.note: DNG, CR2, CRW, NEF, NRW, ORF, RW2, PEF, SR2, RAF plus recent RAW formats; RAW+JPG grouping

img_psd_exr.note: PSD and EXR (also Clip Studio CLIP in PRO)

img_animated.note: Animated GIF, WebP, PNG, BPG, AVIF

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, [ ] for next/previous folder or archive

slideshow.note: Ctrl+1…9 starts a slideshow with 1–9 s per image

slideshow_recursive.note: Images only, folder by folder; no videos

auto_enhance_view.note: Manual view filters: soften/sharpen, gamma, brightness, contrast, grayscale, sepia; no auto enhance

file_info_exif.note: EXIF, XMP, GPS on map, Stable Diffusion prompts (no video codecs: no video)
